summary: You can free yourself from old emotional patterns when you choose to. The capacity to feel and adapt at once is there, available when you reach for it.
body: You can free yourself from old emotional patterns when you choose to. The capacity to feel and adapt at once is there, available when you reach for it. Left unused, you repeat the familiar even when it doesn't serve you. But when you let yourself try a new emotional move, ask for what you actually need, break a pattern you inherited, things shift fast. The opening rewards nerve. Reach for it and your feelings stop running on old programming.
gift: At your best: emotionally adaptable and free once you choose it.
shadow: The trap: repeating the inherited pattern when a new move is right there.
integration: Let emotional needs and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Good for inventive moves and breaking stale routines; poor for steady, predictable handling.
do: Try a new emotional move on purpose
Ask for what you actually need
dont: Wait for change to happen to you
